principle: The generator distinguishes a reusable ship design/class from an individual vessel. A new procedural civilian design may later produce many persistent ships.
procedural_design_rules: Generate a procedural design only when no valid canonical/authored design is selected and the operator/role has a procedural design grammar.
Procedural design_id is deterministic and persistent once introduced.
A procedural design is not regenerated per ship.
Technology must be legal/available for date and operator.
Military capability cannot be added to a civilian design without operator/legal/mission justification.
Civilian design geometry follows operator/era visual grammar and functional capacity, not random kitbashing.
Procedural designs may be reused by traffic generation according to production availability/rarity.
canonical_rules: Canonical class definitions are immutable design data.
Canonical unique ships are separate individual entities and reserved.
Generated ships may use canonical classes without copying a canonical ship name, registry, crew or history.
